entities.name: CNGB3
observations: The 768-residue query sequence is a near-complete vertebrate cyclic nucleotide-gated channel beta-3 protein; it matches reviewed canine CNGB3 Q8MJD7 at 100% identity and 100% query coverage.
It matches reviewed human CNGB3 Q9NQW8 at 74.4% identity across 100% query coverage.
The sequence contains an Ion_trans domain (PF00520) at residues 215-447 and a cNMP_binding domain (PF00027) at residues 539-624.
Predicted sequence properties: molecular mass approximately 87.8 kDa, theoretical pI approximately 9.0, and positive net charge at pH 7.
CNGB3 is a pore-forming beta subunit of cone photoreceptor cyclic nucleotide-gated channels, conducting cGMP- and cAMP-gated currents permeable to Na+ and Ca2+.
Reviewed homolog annotations place CNGB3 in photoreceptor outer-segment membranes as a multipass membrane protein.

entities.name: Q8MJD7
observations: Reviewed canine cyclic nucleotide-gated channel beta-3 reference protein; 100% identity to the query over the full query length.
Annotated as a cone photoreceptor outer-segment membrane pore-forming subunit involved in cGMP-dependent phototransduction.

entities.name: Q9NQW8
observations: Reviewed human cyclic nucleotide-gated channel beta-3 reference protein; 74.4% identity to the query across the full query length.

entities.name: Cone phototransduction
observations: CNGB3-containing cyclic nucleotide-gated channels convert changes in intracellular cGMP into electrical responses in cone photoreceptors.
